name: Endeavour (STS-88)
about: Endeavour (STS-88) (1998-069A), a crewed vehicle (OV-105), launched 1998 Dec  4. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1998 Dec  6), held fixed
docked to A06140; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
